title: PREMVP ECONOMIC_TELEMETRY_V1 consumer callback
description: Portable contract for POST /api/executor/order-events. ECONOMIC_TELEMETRY_V1 is persisted at executor_order_events.executor_meta.economic_telemetry_v1.

stake_usd.description: Requested authorized stake. Must not exceed the queued stake_usd.

submitted_price.description: Requested limit/submitted price. Must not exceed the queued max_entry_price.

submitted_size.description: Requested shares. submitted_price × submitted_size must not exceed the queued stake_usd.

economicTelemetryInput.description: Optional economic enrichment. The deployed parser also accepts these fields at the callback root when this object is absent. Numeric strings are accepted here only; the required callback admission fields above must be JSON numbers.

x-numeric-semantics: All stored numbers must be finite. Requested notional is rounded to 8 decimals as submitted_price × submitted_size. Executed notional is calculated from executed_shares × average_fill_price when both are known; a supplied contradictory executed_notional_usd is rejected. A null observation is never zero.
x-idempotency: The existing execution is identified by idempotency_key and clob_order_id, with queue_id, reservation_id, condition_id, token_id, and side required to match the queue-derived stored identity. First admission inserts. A later callback with the same canonical event fields is duplicate=true and may enrich the same executor_meta record. A changed canonical event or reused clob_order_id is a 409 conflict. A later null/non-known observation never erases a previously KNOWN observation. A queue already EXECUTED is never downgraded by a later rejection.
x-wallet-lifecycle: PRE_SUBMIT and POST_SUBMIT require wallet_capture_evidence exactly CAPTURED_AT_<lifecycle>. CURRENT_SNAPSHOT needs no historical attestation and must not be represented as historical evidence. The deployed validator has no monotonic lifecycle/downgrade rule: a later explicitly attested lifecycle value is accepted; only an unattested PRE_SUBMIT or POST_SUBMIT claim is rejected, surfaced by the route as HTTP 500 ECONOMIC_TELEMETRY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED.

exact_duplicate.semantics: The same stored event is returned; economic telemetry persistence is re-run against the prior record.
